captions.detailed: A wall-mounted medical-grade air purifier with a flat-back rectangular grey housing. A front-facing filter access panel is hinged at the base, designed to fold downward to expose the inner filter cavity. Detent latches at the upper corners hold the panel shut, while a narrow vented face grille runs along the front.
captions.instruction: Create a wall-mounted medical-grade air purifier with a flat-back rectangular housing, a front-facing filter access panel hinged at the base, and two mechanical detent latches at the upper corners.
captions.factory: Construct the main body housing as a large rectangular Box primitive. Model the front access panel as a thinner Box offset from the main body. Add two cylindrical hinges at the base using Cylinder primitives, and place two detent latch assemblies at the upper left and right corners using combined Box and Cylinder shapes.
